facts.fact: The Ministry of the Interior said on 31 August 2026 that a request for a translated birth extract made on the online services platform e-bawaba.tn is referred directly to the municipality where the birth was registered and can be followed through its processing stages on the same platform; the document gives no count of municipalities and does not say how their offices are connected.
facts.system: e-bawaba.tn (requests referred to the municipality of registration)

facts.fact: The Ministry of the Interior, with the Ministry of Communication Technologies, launched on 31 August 2026 a remote service for translated birth extracts whose requests are referred directly to the municipality of registration.
facts.system: e-bawaba.tn (requests referred to the municipality of registration)

systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, with the Ministry of Communication Technologies
systems.tiers: Citizens online; requests referred to the municipality where the birth was registered

note: Facts rest on the study's rule that a municipality handling transactions in a national system states a connection; the document says only that requests are referred to the municipality, not that staff work them online at the office.
